summary: Delivered Phase 2 frontend features: reflection evidence curation (1~2 items + 1-line meaning) and 7-day 3-tier read-only 3D replay (Completed, Interrupted, Supporting Evidence). Added Close/Skip CTAs to the 3D environment with Streamlit fallback buttons. Maintained non-blocking core loop and optimized rerun stability.
